instruction: A cluster of floating islands in a bright sky: grassy chunks of earth with exposed rocky undersides, waterfalls pouring off edges into mist, rope bridges linking the islands, a tiny cottage with a windmill on the largest, floating boulders, a small airship moored to a post, birds circling below, and drifting clouds casting soft shadows.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene: Floating Sky Islands. A cluster of floating islands in a bright sky: grassy chunks of earth with exposed rocky undersides, waterfalls pouring off edges into mist, rope bridges linking the islands, a tiny cottage with a windmill on the largest, floating boulders, a small airship moored to a post, birds circling below, and drifting clouds casting soft shadows. Style: ghibli-inspired fantasy. Entirely procedural geometry and textures (no external assets; canvas-generated textures are allowed). Compose a full environment — ground/backdrop plus several distinct focal structures and rich supporting props — with style-appropriate materials, a deliberate lighting rig with shadows, atmospheric depth (fog or a gradient sky where fitting), and subtle looping animation on at least three elements. Include OrbitControls with gentle auto-rotate, ACES filmic tone mapping, and a seeded PRNG so the layout is reproducible. Target roughly 600-700 lines of well-organized code.
